result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts`. I haven't run or tested it.

- `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`.
- `createDownloadLink` sets it to 7 days after creation. It formats the value with `toUtcIso()` from `src/time.ts`, which gives second-precision UTC, as the repo requires.
- The URL now looks like `?token=...&expires=<expiresAt>`, with the timestamp URL-encoded.

This only adds the expiry to the link. I didn't touch the code that serves downloads, so nothing rejects an expired link yet. The server that handles these URLs will need to check `expires` itself.

Since this changes the link format, the repo's lessons say to tag @jordan on the PR.
